title: Singularity H3 replaces our H3 transformers (one fused file for t2v / i2v / ref2v), licence check first
description: Fabio, 2026-10-25 (MPI-1135 Phase 1): Singularity v1.3 beats our H3 by a small margin on fast motion, at the same speed. Replace. Version (v1.3 or v2) is decided by MPI-1135's follow-up test on Shot B. Before wiring: (1) licence check. The source repo says apache-2.0, but it is an H3 fine-tune, so treat it as bound by the H3 Community Licence and its territory clause. (2) Follow docs/playbooks/add-model/README.md 'Removing or re-tiering': never delete the old dep entries. One 21 GB file replaces both fl2va and ref2va.
